lead_raw_text:
The structure of Fe₃Ge₂ (Fe₁₈Ge₁₂ per cell) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with 30 atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Fe and Ge centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each; Fe centers have 9 Fe and 3 Ge neighbors, while Ge centers have 6 Fe and 6 Ge neighbors, with neighbor distances near 2.57–2.69 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 30 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Fe-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Fe- and Ge-centered polyhedra.
